title: Modsender
description: ModSender is the required client-side companion mod for Mod Checker Enhanced. It automatically sends your mod list to the server upon joining, allowing server administrators to enforce whitelists and detect unauthorized mods.
body:
![Modsender](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62df71fea87700093836aee672baa25791019e90_0.webp)

⚠️ NOTE This is only a mod. If u want your server to use this mod you need to install the Mod Checker Enhanced plugin. Please contact the creator if you need any help!

[Link to Mod Checker Enhanced!](https://modrinth.com/plugin/modcheckerenhanced)

## **Overview**
ModSender is the client-side companion mod for ModCheckerEnhanced. It automatically sends your mod list to the server upon joining, allowing the server to verify that all your mods are whitelisted. Without ModSender, the server will reject your connection.

## **Requirements**
- Minecraft: 1.21.x
- Mods: Fabric API
- Server: Mod Checker Enhanced

## **Installation**
1. Download the ModSender JAR file
2. Place it in your client's mods folder
3. Launch Minecraft with Fabric Loader
4. Join any server running ModChecker

**Modsender - The essential to keep Minecraft servers as fair as possible.**
